arStrings.szText: "Did you know what would happen in Temis?"
In a way, I’d foreseen it—and other horrors like it. Skovos sinking into a sea of blood. My sisters, ripping me limb from limb.
Adreona, dead at the hands of a loved one.
Mephisto had meddled with my other visions—why not this one, too? But that is his way. Confusion, misdirection. By the time I knew for sure, it was too late to prevent it.
